- **architecture:** Monolithic Magento + Hyva frontend; Magewire 1.13; local-dev config (file cache + file sessions)

## 3. Technical Inventory (blueprint §7A)
- **custom modules:**
  - `Secomm_Base` — admin shell + config tab (low risk)
  - `Secomm_AddressDropdown` — AJAX hierarchical address dropdowns + GraphQL (medium risk)
  - `Secomm_VietNamAddress` — VN address data set (low risk)
  - `Secomm_VNPAY` — VNPAY payment gateway Pay/Info/IPN, default inactive (high risk)
- **third-party modules (source-committed):** 16 Mageplaza modules — Core, Osc/OscPro/OscUltimate,
  SocialLogin/Pro, Smtp, GeoIP, ExtraFee, DeliveryTime, TableRateShipping, QuickCart, Lookbook,
  AbandonedCart, ThankYouPage, BackendReindex
- **composer deps:** hyva-themes/magento2-default-theme 1.5.2, mollie/magento2 3.1.1 (+hyva-compat 3.1.0),
  magewirephp/magewire 1.13.3, tailwindcss ^4.3.1
- **theme overrides:** Hyva theme-fallback + base-layout-reset + compat-module-fallback
- **cron jobs:** mageplaza_abandonedcart_cron (every min), smtp_clear_log (daily 00:00), core feed (hourly)
- **integrations:** Mollie (active), VNPAY (inactive), Mageplaza SMTP/SocialLogin/AbandonedCart
- **NOT present:** ERP/OMS, Klaviyo/Mailchimp, ElasticSuite/Smile, Amasty/Mirasvit, RabbitMQ
